aiMachineReadReview.answer: The root-domain llms index links directly to the English Python quickstart. Its runnable path is: create/activate a virtual environment, install `ankiforge==0.3.1` with pip, save the supplied Project/Note/BuildOptions example as `main.py`, and run `python main.py`. The result is persistent `spanish.apkg` containing hola → hello in the Spanish deck. Use ordinary CPython 3.11+ and a matching native wheel; the documented test range is 3.11–3.14, not every Python implementation. Windows has its own activation command, `.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1`. Namespace `spanish` and note key `es:hola` must remain stable across edits. Anki is needed to import/view the result, not for generation; the API explains that closing a persistent artifact does not delete its file. Sources: [quickstart](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/python-quickstart/index.md), [runtime coverage](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/compatibility/index.md), [artifact API](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/python-api/index.md).

aiMachineReadReview.answer: The root artifact provides the actual Node/TypeScript reference, not a fallback page. Start on Node 22.13+ with `npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1`; use `.mjs` for ESM or require for CommonJS. `Project.add` collects an explicitly keyed note, while `await project.build(BuildOptions.to(path))` returns output with artifact, report and snapshot. Retain an owner while reading temporary paths; persistent paths survive close. Media loading, bundle loading, build and comparison are asynchronous. Compare's success must be separated from `policy.allows_publication`; default policy blocks High/Critical findings. For update calls, preserve the original APKG and use `updateFrom`. Read native properties in camelCase and Rust-compatible snapshot properties in snake_case. TypeScript's documented path uses NodeNext, ES2022 and emitted `.mjs`. Sources: [API](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/node-api/index.md), [installation and runnable example](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/node-quickstart/index.md).

aiMachineReadReview.answer: The three linked English guides provide a complete update path. Download the four recipe inputs into recipe/, choose the documented Rust/Python/TypeScript program, and use a fresh output directory. In Python, `python main.py recipe output/python` generates v1, records a comparison against it, prepares v2 with `update_from(baseline)`, checks the prepared comparison and publishes that candidate. The stable namespace is biology-json and each row's durable id is its note key. Both packages should contain 3 notes, 3 cards and 2 media assets; the new version changes the first answer and records RISK.NOTE_CHANGED without additions/removals. Keep the original v1 distribution and the reports. Never replace that baseline with an Anki re-export. Test first import and subsequent update in the target client, including local edits/scheduling; omission is not deletion synchronization. Sources: [JSON workflow](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/json-to-anki/index.md), [identity and policy](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/updates/index.md), [media behavior](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/media/index.md).

aiMachineReadReview.answer: The root-domain compatibility text reports a dated 0.3.1 verification matrix: Rust 1.92, Node 22.13 plus current 22/24/26, and CPython 3.11–3.14. Its native targets are macOS arm64/x64, Linux x64 glibc and Windows x64; it explicitly excludes a universal host/runtime guarantee. Node's recorded scope excludes browser, Electron, Bun, musl and ARM64 Linux/Windows. Other Python implementations and free-threaded/subinterpreter use require separate validation. Build success certifies an APKG artifact, not every Anki import, renderer, codec, local edit or schedule. Updates need the original distribution evidence. The output guide distinguishes persistent and last-owner temporary files, hard inspection failures, per-file atomic replacement, and late failure after publication with unconfirmed durability. Prepared publication is included in public 0.3.1 despite the older English subsection heading. Sources: [compatibility](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/compatibility/index.md), [output guarantees](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/build-guarantees/index.md).

aiMachineReadReview.answer: La receta española del dominio raíz parte de dos JSON y dos archivos multimedia en recipe/. Selecciona uno de los tres programas completos; con Python ejecuta `python main.py recipe output/python` después de instalar 0.3.1, usando una salida nueva. Se conserva v1.apkg, se compara v2 y se escribe comparison.json; después se prepara la actualización desde ese original, se revisa de nuevo la política y se publica el candidato ya revisado. El resultado esperado es tres notas, tres tarjetas y dos recursos por versión; RISK.NOTE_CHANGED describe el cambio de la primera respuesta, sin altas ni bajas. Conserva biology-json y los ID persistentes de las filas. No uses una reexportación de Anki como referencia. Las eliminaciones omitidas, los cambios locales y el historial de repaso requieren comprobar el cliente; un build correcto no garantiza esos efectos.
